panels.title: Modules down
panels.description: Only modules currently down (up == 0) are plotted. An empty graph means everything is healthy; any line is a module that died. Projectors don't auto-restart, so they stay here until reactivated. Deactivated modules disappear (their gauge expires) rather than showing as down.

panels.title: Active modules by type
panels.description: Number of activated modules currently reporting, per type. A step down without a matching failure means a module was deactivated.

panels.title: Down modules by type
panels.description: Count of activated modules currently down, per type. Should sit at 0.

panels.title: Event lag (modules behind)
panels.description: Only modules with lag > 0 are plotted, measured against each module's own event query so narrowly-subscribed modules don't show false lag. Empty = everything caught up.

panels.title: Time since last progress (top 10)
panels.description: Seconds since each module last committed progress, ten stalest shown. Grows naturally for low-traffic subscriptions, so read alongside lag rather than alone.

panels.title: Failures (last 10m)
panels.description: Modules that died in the last 10 minutes. Empty during healthy operation; any line is a crash.

panels.title: Effect restarts (last 10m)
panels.description: Effects that restarted in the last 10 minutes. A sustained line is a crash loop.

panels.title: Effect restart backoff
panels.description: Effects currently backing off. A climbing value means repeated failures at the same event position.

panels.title: Failures (last 24h)
panels.description: Modules that died at least once in the last day. Surfaces flaky modules that recover but keep dying.

panels.title: Event ingestion rate
panels.description: New events appended to the event store per second (5m rate).

panels.title: Module progress rate
panels.description: Rate at which each module's committed position advances (approximate activity signal). A drop to 0 while events are still being ingested means a module has stalled.

panels.title: Modules per running version
panels.description: Count of active modules on each version, per type. During a rollout the old version's count falls as the new one rises, which is handy for correlating incidents with deploys. To read the exact version of a single module, query umari_module_info directly in the vmui query view.
